_comment: Single source of truth for model ids, thinking parameters and prices. NO model id may appear anywhere else in the code.
Environment of the first version: only Google AI Studio free-tier keys, so all three tiers map to Gemini models.
cheap    -> lightest Flash-Lite: classification, decisions, validation and Auto chat are short, structured and frequent.
balanced -> Flash: best free model for drafting/chat quality per latency; default for deliverables.
frontier -> strongest free-tier model (Pro) for escalations and explicit sensitive runs; Flash is the last candidate if Pro is not free for the key.
`candidates` is an ordered preference list. At server start the configured platform key's model list is fetched
and the FIRST candidate that exists and supports generateContent is used; a warning is logged if it is not the first one.
The ids below were NOT verifiable in the authoring sandbox (no outbound access to the Gemini API) — the startup check is what makes them trustworthy.
Prices are public LIST prices per 1M tokens (USD), used only for the ledger. Free-tier calls cost the user nothing but are still recorded at list price
so unit economics can be measured before paid providers are added. Re-verify at every pricing review (see docs/PRD.md, review dates).

thinking._comment: effort -> provider parameter. thinkingBudget: 0 = off, -1 = dynamic, otherwise a token budget.
Pro cannot switch thinking off, so 'minimal' maps to the smallest allowed budget.
